text: This is the first study to examine stock price reactions to non- and deferred prosecution agreements, using all publicly available N/DPAs across several industries from 1993 to 2015 (N=330).
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Timothy Lacine, Stock Price Response to Non- and Deferred Prosecution Agreements (2015). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2629451
